meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: Claude 会把网站部署到 Vercel,并给你一个可访问的网址;还能管理 Vercel 项目、域名和环境变量。把网址发给你前,它会先确认网站真的能打开。
howto.when: 当你要求把网站部署到 Vercel,或管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 正式环境
say.note: Claude 会先本地构建,再部署并验证成功。

say.text: 给这个项目添加域名 example.com
say.note: Claude 会执行域名添加操作。

say.text: 把 Vercel 的环境变量拉到本地 .env 文件
say.note: Claude 会从项目拉取并写入本地文件。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Vercel CLI to deploy websites and returns accessible URLs. It can manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables, and verifies the deployment is live before sharing the URL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy a website to Vercel or manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: It builds locally, then deploys and verifies.

say_en.text: Add the domain example.com to this project.
say_en.note: It adds the domain to the project.

say_en.text: Pull Vercel environment variables into the local .env file.
say_en.note: It fetches and writes them locally.
